newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $65.00-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $65.00-USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers steady with bulk of trade Tuesday, USDA said. Inquiry was strong and demand fairly strong. Sales confirmed on 3,100 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 87,500 head confirmed including 19,800 head or about 23 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1275 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1150 lbs 65.00
